newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 5.10 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.10 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with the six-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate (HIBOR) of 5.83173 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.87 percent at the previous tender on February 25.
Bids for the HK$1.0 billion issue were HK$3.13 billion, against HK$3.50 billion at the last tender.
The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills was 4.94 percent at another tender on Tuesday, the HKMA said.
This compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.69231 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.90 percent at the last weekly tender of quarterly bills.
Bids for the HK$2.0 billion issue were HK$7.03 billion, against HK$6.93 billion at the previous tender, the HKMA said.
